# Initialize a database

To create a semantic memory node, you first need to define a schema and initialize the database.

## Schema Definition

The simplest way is to define the schema using the <code>SmemNodeSchema</code> type — an array of field definitions:

```ts
import { useSmem, SmemNodeSchema } from "@agent-smith/smem";

const schema: SmemNodeSchema = [
    { name: "id", type: "int" },
    { name: "title", type: "string" },
    { name: "text", type: "string" },
    { name: "tags", type: "string" },
];
```

The possible field types are: <code>string</code>, <code>int</code>, <code>float</code>, or <code>boolean</code>. Each field can optionally have a <code>nullable</code> property (defaults to `false`).

## Initialize the Database

Create a memory instance and initialize it with a database path:

```ts
import { useSmem } from "@agent-smith/smem";
import path from "path";

const mem = useSmem();
await mem.init(path.join(process.cwd(), "my-memory"));
```

The optional <kbd>isVerbose</kbd> parameter enables console logging:

```ts
const mem = useSmem(true);  // verbose mode
```

## Create a Node from Schema

After initialization, create a node (table) by specifying its name, schema, and the vector source column:

```ts
const documents = await mem.node("documents", schema, "text");
```

The three parameters are:
1. <kbd>name</kbd> — The table/node name in the database
2. <kbd>schema</kbd> — The field schema definition (array of <code>SmemNodeFieldSchema</code>)
3. <kbd>vectorSourceCol</kbd> — The column name whose text content will be embedded into vectors

The vector source column is required because LanceDB needs to know which column to embed. Other columns are stored as-is and can be used for filtering.

## Create a Node from Raw Data

To create a node directly from data (schema is inferred):

```ts
const documents = await mem.nodeFromData("documents", [
    { id: 1, title: "Hello", text: "World" },
    { id: 2, title: "Foo", text: "Bar" },
], "text");
```

## Apache Arrow Schema

For more control, you can define a schema using Apache Arrow types directly:

```ts
import { useSmem } from "@agent-smith/smem";
import { Schema, Field, Float64, Int32, Utf8, FixedSizeList } from "apache-arrow";

const arrowSchema = new Schema([
    new Field("id", new Int32(), false),
    new Field("title", new Utf8()),
    new Field("text", new Utf8()),
    new Field("tags", new Utf8()),
    new Field(
        "vector",
        new FixedSizeList(384, new Field("value", new Float64())),
        false
    ),
]);

const documents = await mem.nodeFromSchema("documents", arrowSchema, "text");
```

The <kbd>vector</kbd> column is mandatory and must be a <code>FixedSizeList</code> of 384 <code>Float64</code> values.

## Listing Nodes

To list all created nodes (tables):

```ts
const nodeNames = await mem.nodeNames();
// Returns: string[] — e.g., ["documents", "articles"]
```

## Open an Existing Node

To reopen a previously created node:

```ts
const table = await mem.openTable("documents");
```
